q: What goes into the CBAM figure for DAP made at Aqaba?
title: Aqaba DAP: the CBAM figure
short: DAP is a CBAM good. Its figure includes the plant's direct emissions, electricity, and the embedded emissions of ammonia used, which is usually bought in. Phosphoric acid is not a CBAM good, so its energy enters only through the DAP plant's own fuel and power.
audience: Jordanian fertiliser producers exporting DAP to the EU and their importers

p: Ammonia is a CBAM precursor for DAP. Ask the ammonia supplier for its embedded emissions, or use the EU default, which is usually higher.
Not listed in CBAM. If made on site, its fuel and power are part of the installation and need a clear boundary.

senseible: Senseible keeps each site's fuel, power and production records together, so the embedded emissions you send an EU importer trace back to dated documents.
